label: Distance to nearest regulatory air monitor (mean of PM2.5, NO2, SO2, ozone)

source.name: EPA AirData annual concentration by monitor; aqs_monitors

notes: Straight-line km from the tract's center point to the nearest EPA regulatory monitor that reported any valid data for the pollutant that year (complete or not), averaged over PM2.5, NO2, SO2 and ozone. Per-pollutant distances are in 'detail'.
Tract center is the area-weighted centroid of the 2020 tract polygon; where that centroid falls outside an irregular tract, a point inside the tract on the same latitude is used.
Monitors within 150 km of Memphis were considered (PM2.5 FRM/FEM 88101, NO2 42602, SO2 42401, ozone 44201).
The only SO2 monitor in the area is the Memphis NCore site, so the SO2 distance is the distance to NCore for every tract.
2026 is omitted: Shelby County's monitors had not yet reported any 2026 data to EPA's AirData files, so a 2026 value would show a false gap.
